messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: High p95 latency on /v1/generate in prod-us-west (>= 2.3s) — 30m window. Alert rule: api.latency.p95 >= 2s. Routing: eng-oncall.
Priya Patel: on it, grabbing dashboards. which customers are hitting this?
Ethan Cole: seeing queue depth spike on inference-queue-prod, +3x in 10m. GPU node pools are near capacity (util ~98%).
Lydia Zhang: confirmed. HPA scale events not triggering last 8m, metric server shows stale metrics.
Priya Patel: @Samir can you check autoscaler logs? I’ll open the main trace and customer impact list.
Samir Rao: looking. HPA emitted scale recommendation but kube-controller failed with 'resourceVersion conflict' from 13:42:12 - possible API throttling.
ops-bot: Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/prod/inference-queue?from=now-1h to dashboard (shard: us-west).
Ethan Cole: adding notes — prefix cache miss rate jumped from 12% to 72% after a deploy ~35m ago. cold KV cache + saturated GPUs = long warmup per replica.
Lydia Zhang: timeline I'm assembling: 13:05 deploy -> 13:25 small latency bump -> 13:40 traffic spike (customer B) -> 13:42 HPA errors start -> 13:45 p95 > 2s -> 13:48 page.
Priya Patel: mitigation options: 1) increase reserved GPU pool (spin extra nodes), 2) route low-priority traffic to smaller model variant, 3) rollback recent deploy. Thoughts?
Samir Rao: can we temporarily enable model-variant fallback for non-enterprise tokens? I can flip routing rule in ~2m.
Ethan Cole: yes that should reduce token load on big GPUs. Set fallback to cpu-x2 endpoint for background jobs.
Lydia Zhang: also recommend patching autoscaler pod to retry on resourceVersion conflict. quick patch could restore HPA decisions.
Priya Patel: prioritize patient customer impact: runbook says notify enterprise if >1% errors or latency >1.5s for 15m. Currently 4 customers see degraded p95. I'll start comms.
Samir Rao: /k logs from autoscaler: ```
2026-06-01T13:42:11Z ERROR controller: failed to update HPA scale status: conflict (resourceVersion)
2026-06-01T13:42:12Z WARN metrics: stale metrics reading for namespace prod
2026-06-01T13:43:30Z INFO attempts: retrying scale update (attempt 2)
```
Ethan Cole: infra commands I ran: ```
kubectl get hpa -n prod inference-hpa -o yaml
kubectl describe nodes -l pool=inference-gpu-usw
kubectl get sts -n prod inference-pool -o wide
```
Logs show kube API 429s around 13:42.
Lydia Zhang: customer impact list (from topk tokens): CustomerA (heavy batch), CustomerB (spike), CustomerC (small). I'll attach logs to incident ticket.
Priya Patel: mitigation decision: Samir, enable routing fallback for non-enterprise. Ethan, request +2 GPU nodes (burst) from Dedicated pool. Lydia, start timeline doc and capture traces for sample request id list.
Samir Rao: flipping route now. patch: ```json
{"rule":"if tier != enterprise then route->model-x-small"}
```
Samir Rao: done. edge-router logs show immediate 18% drop in big-model requests.
Ethan Cole: requested +2 nodes via cloud console and bumped pool target from 10 -> 12. Provisioning started (ETA ~4m).
ops-bot: Cloud provider event: provisioning nodes for pool inference-gpu-usw - operation id op-8a7c.
Lydia Zhang: tracing note: sample request 0f3a9c shows cold KV fetch 1.2s and model init 0.9s. combined warmup ~2.1s. cache miss rate correlated with deploy timestamp.
Priya Patel: good. monitor p95 for next 10m and decide on rollback if not improving. Comms: posting customer note to #customer-status with short summary.
Ethan Cole: p95 dropped to 1.4s at 13:50 after fallback + node provisioning. queue depth reduced from 1.2k -> 420.
Lydia Zhang: HPA controller now recovering, processed backlog of scale updates at 13:53. No more resourceVersion conflicts.
Samir Rao: autoscaler patch queued as PR #4021 to add exponential backoff on update conflicts. I'll link in the RCA.
Priya Patel: good work. Next steps: collect full timeline, attach autoscaler logs, edge-router routing change, node provisioning events, and sample traces. We'll schedule a 30m RCA sync tomorrow 11:00am.
Ethan Cole: adding postmortem items: - verify deploys warmup KV seeded before traffic; - increase kube API rate limit for autoscaler service account; - add canary for prefix-cache compatibility.
Lydia Zhang: I'll add those to the RCA doc and set owners.
Priya Patel: thanks team. marking incident resolved-> degraded at 13:58 after p95 stable <1.2s. Final note: follow up with infra for HPA controller tuning. :thumbsup:
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by Priya Patel (oncall).
